input.summary: Cap audit frequency at once per 12 months and require 30 days' prior written notice under Paragraph 9.8.
input.comment: [Playbook] We added a once-per-twelve-months limit and thirty (30) days' prior written notice to the Paragraph 9 review/audit right, which is currently unlimited in frequency and requires no notice. Our playbook position is one audit per 12 months on 30 days' notice during business hours; we are content to leave the existing cost allocation (requesting Party bears the compliance costs) unchanged, and can accept 15 days' notice if that works better for the F&ASC's procedures.

ops.oldText: Any Party shall have the right to review or audit the relevant books, records, vouchers, and accounts of costs pursuant to this Paragraph 9.
ops.newText: Any Party shall have the right, not more than once in any twelve (12) month period and on not less than thirty (30) days' prior written notice, to review or audit during normal business hours the relevant books, records, vouchers, and accounts of costs pursuant to this Paragraph 9.
